headword: {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}
gloss: freedom of expression; freedom of speech

definitions.gloss: freedom of expression; freedom of speech
definitions.explanation: The right to express ideas, opinions, and information freely through speech, writing, art, and other media. A fundamental right guaranteed by Article 21 of the Japanese Constitution.

notes:
A fundamental legal and political concept. In Japan, {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう} is protected under {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧21{条|じょう} (Article 21 of the Japanese Constitution), which also guarantees freedom of assembly, association, and the press.
